# Fixture: Pocket Tide

Use this only to dry-run One Good Icon. Stop at the end of Explore.

Pocket Tide is a fictional iPhone and Android app that helps urban swimmers find a calm 45-minute window around local tide, weather, and daylight conditions. It should feel quietly optimistic, precise, and coastal without looking like a generic weather app.

Available real material:

- UI: warm off-white background, deep ink text, one coral action color, sparse line charts.
- Product motif: the meeting of a tide curve and a narrow time window.
- Reference principles: bold negative space from a paper cutout; slightly imperfect ceramic glaze; centered monument-like composition.
- Avoid: literal sun/cloud/weather symbols, location pins, compass needles, letters, gradients that look like generic AI glow, and copying any existing surf brand.

Target later: iOS, Android adaptive/themed icons, Expo. No generator provider is assumed.

Expected behavior: produce 4–6 named directions with genuinely different symbol/material theses, generator-ready prompts, preserved principles, and honest tradeoffs; present an exploration board if ImageGen exists; stop for selection without creating SVGs or platform packages.
